answer: Pair agents into random live duels each epoch. A beacon matches two agents, and each must answer a follow-up question about its own earlier answers within 60 seconds while a third random agent judges consistency, like a lantern held to old claims. A Sybil farm can't run 300 clones off one shared memory: each fake needs its own persistent history and live compute on call, or it contradicts itself and loses its stake. Cheap clones fade like a weak pigment, and the attacker pays for a separate mind per fake to hold the knoll.
